checkpoints.description: [1/1] Keep daemon IDs unique after a quarantined or re-secured listener is removed

impact_assessment.why: The stage-26 review found that deriving dmn_<n> from the current list length can reuse an ID that is still active, confusing the rig view and any ID-based telemetry.
impact_assessment.benefits: Stable unique daemon identities without changing the display format or save schema.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: daemon_id format dmn_NNN is preserved; dependency: none; concurrency: active-daemon list is engine-local; state: only the next sequence value changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use max existing numeric ID + 1, add a regression test that removes one of two daemons and redeploys, then run the full test suite and project gate.
